gate: M3 V4.3 Systemic Pre-Scoring Closure Gate
classification_rule: A family is stochastic iff any classification_evidence variability flag is true and no universal proof covers that source. A family is deterministic only when every variability flag is false and exact_basis names a finite/algebraic/interface construction. reference_type must equal this independently derived result.

L5.oracle.exact_basis: ground-truth equality and exact access count

L5.shuffled.exact_basis: finite order invariance and fixed-point-free edge proof

raw_artifact_common_contract.manifest_encoding: UTF-8 JSON, object keys sorted lexicographically, no NaN or Infinity
raw_artifact_common_contract.numeric_array_encoding: raw C-row-major little-endian two's-complement int64 or IEEE-754 binary64; booleans uint8 restricted to 0 or 1; no padding
raw_artifact_common_contract.string_encoding: Unicode NFC encoded UTF-8 with byte length in manifest
raw_artifact_common_contract.finite_check: every binary64 element must be finite
raw_artifact_common_contract.judge_rule: JUDGE reads raw arrays, verifies shape/dtype/order/length/hash, and recomputes every summary without importing producer summaries

L1.frozen.judge_recomputes: entry aggregation, bin means, OLS R2, null ranks, p-value

L1.fair_naive.judge_recomputes: ranks, accessibility, bin means, OLS R2, null ranks, p-value

L1.permuted.judge_recomputes: mapped pairs, tied ranks, Spearman rho, absolute statistic, p-value

L1.shuffled.judge_recomputes: realized counts, ranks, accessibility, five tied Spearman rhos, maxima, p-value

L3.frozen.judge_recomputes: sequence, fits, predictions, component losses, reductions, max statistic, p-value

L3.oracle.judge_recomputes: sequence, fits, predictions, component losses, reductions, two-sided violation maximum, p-value

L3.permuted.judge_recomputes: sequence, fit, transform, predictions, losses, reductions, max statistic, p-value

L3.shuffled.judge_recomputes: sequence shuffle, fit, predictions, paired component losses, five differences, max statistic, p-value

L5.permuted.judge_recomputes: all correctness indicators, accuracy, pooled departures, mismatch rate, p-value

rng_protocol.integer_encoding: unsigned big-endian: scoring seed uint64, replicate index uint32, subdraw index uint32, counter uint64
rng_protocol.component_encoding: UTF-8 NFC preceded by uint16 big-endian byte length
rng_protocol.key_formula: SHA256(root_domain || 0x00 || enc(law) || enc(arm) || enc(draw_role) || u64be(scoring_seed) || u32be(replicate_index) || u32be(subdraw_index))
rng_protocol.observed_role: OBSERVED; replicate_index=0; subdraw_index identifies the statistic component
rng_protocol.null_role: NULL; replicate_index=0..999; subdraw_index identifies the statistic component
rng_protocol.stream_formula: block_c = SHA256(key || u64be(c)), c=0,1,...; concatenate blocks
rng_protocol.uniform_integer: consume non-overlapping uint64 big-endian words; for modulus m reject x >= floor(2^64/m)*m, otherwise return x mod m
rng_protocol.derangement: generate consecutive Fisher-Yates permutations from the same stream and accept the first with no fixed point
rng_protocol.cross_platform_rule: No platform RNG, language hash, native-endian conversion, floating draw, or percentile interpolation is permitted
rng_protocol.exchangeability: OBSERVED and NULL use the same finite sample space, SHA-256 counter stream, rejection sampler, and transform; only the domain role and replicate index differ. Hence every assignment is generated by the same uniform algorithm, with disjoint deterministic streams. The plus-one randomization rank is valid under the specified pseudorandom-exchangeability model.

families.direction_justification: Large R2 means the constant-priority/tie-break control leaks age structure; smaller R2 is stronger destruction.
families.reference: 1000 exchangeable random tie-break permutations per scoring seed; statistic R2
families.corrective_method: Upper-tail plus-one randomization p-value per seed, p=(1+#{R2_null>=R2_obs})/1001; Bonferroni alpha_seed=0.05/3; order statistic 985 is reporting shorthand only.

families.direction_justification: Large R2 means an allegedly unrelated ranking leaks age structure; smaller R2 is stronger destruction.
families.reference: 1000 exchangeable unrelated identifier permutations per scoring seed; statistic R2
families.corrective_method: Upper-tail plus-one randomization p-value per seed with Bonferroni alpha_seed=0.05/3; order statistic 985 is nonbinding shorthand.

families.direction_justification: Age fit must remain present while every rehearsal association must remain below its absence bar; each direction follows the factor-isolation claim.
families.reference: Fixed structural fixture, candidate-set schedule, priority equation, and tie-break; scoring seed does not enter this arm.

pre_correction_fwfp.derivation: Exact fixed-fixture predicates are not level-alpha hypothesis tests; duplicated reporting under three scoring seeds adds no random comparisons.

families.corrective_method: None. Pre-scoring exact satisfiability must recompute all seven values once and verify byte-identical replication across seed slots; any mismatch is construction failure, not sampling rejection.

families.direction_justification: The removed age factor must not retain negative direction and rehearsal must remain present in every bin.
families.reference: Fixed structural fixture, candidate-set schedule, priority equation, and tie-break; scoring seed does not enter this arm.

pre_correction_fwfp.derivation: Exact fixed-fixture predicates, not level-alpha tests.

families.corrective_method: None; exact pre-scoring satisfiability and cross-slot identity verification.

checks: abs(Spearman_rho_age_accessibility_200) is not unusually large under mapping permutation
families.direction_justification: Either strong positive or strong negative association means permutation retained systematic predictor-label correspondence; sign is immaterial.
families.reference: V4.2 200-entry Spearman statistic; 1000 exchangeable age/rehearsal mapping permutations per seed; test statistic abs(rho)
families.corrective_method: Plus-one randomization p-value on abs(rho), p=(1+#{abs(rho_null)>=abs(rho_obs)})/1001, Bonferroni alpha_seed=0.05/3. Retain null p95<=0.15 as a single pre-scoring deterministic power check, not three stochastic tests.

families.direction_justification: Excess positive rho means shuffle retained rehearsal signal; lower rho means stronger destruction and is informational only.
families.reference: 1000 exchangeable priming-query reassignments per seed; within-replicate statistic max of five bin rhos
families.corrective_method: V4.3 upper-only null-of-the-max within seed; plus-one p-value; Bonferroni alpha_seed=0.05/3 across seeds; binding p-value and order statistic 985 shorthand.

families.direction_justification: Each exact oracle predicate follows the positive fixture definition; any violation identifies construction failure.
families.reference: Oracle uses fixed ground-truth priority on the fixed structural fixture.

pre_correction_fwfp.derivation: Exact oracle construction checks, not stochastic tests.

families.corrective_method: None; exact satisfiability and cross-slot identity verification.

checks: defined error returned and no numeric statistic
families.direction_justification: Any numeric result on an empty fixture violates the defined interface.
families.reference: Empty fixture contract.

checks: reduction_h shows no unusually large positive frozen-state benefit for h=1..5
families.direction_justification: Positive frozen-state benefit undermines the negative control; smaller or negative reduction is stronger destruction.
families.reference: 1000 exchangeable AR(3) innovation draws per seed with the identical frozen-state and baseline fitting pipeline; statistic max_h reduction_h.

pre_correction_fwfp.derivation: The former <=0 finite-sample claim had no universal proof; conservative bound is unbounded=1.

families.corrective_method: Upper-only five-horizon null-of-the-max plus-one randomization p-value with 1000 full-pipeline null draws per seed and Bonferroni alpha_seed=0.05/3.

checks: oracle reduction is not unusually outside the adopted 0.05..0.95 validity interval over h=1..5
families.direction_justification: Reduction below 0.05 indicates an ineffective oracle and above 0.95 indicates a ceiling/corner; both directions are fixture failures.
families.reference: 1000 exchangeable AR(3) innovation draws per seed with identical fitting; per horizon violation v_h=max(0.05-reduction_h,reduction_h-0.95), statistic max_h v_h.

pre_correction_fwfp.derivation: The former interval was applied to random finite-sample fits without a universal proof; conservative bound is 1.

families.corrective_method: Two-sided interval-violation null-of-the-max plus-one randomization p-value over five horizons, 1000 full-pipeline null draws per seed, Bonferroni alpha_seed=0.05/3. The 0.05 and 0.95 anchors and both failure directions are retained in v_h.

checks: reduction_h does not show excessive positive benefit for h=1..5
families.direction_justification: Only positive predictive benefit after channel derangement undermines the negative control; more-negative reduction is stronger destruction.
families.reference: 1000 exchangeable uniformly sampled 8-channel derangements per seed; within-replicate statistic max_h reduction_h

pre_correction_fwfp.derivation: The old <=0 claim was explicitly unproved (NF8); conservative pre-closure bound is unbounded=1.

families.corrective_method: Replace the unproved exact bound with upper-only null-of-the-max randomization p-value over five horizons, 1000 derangement null draws per seed, and Bonferroni alpha_seed=0.05/3.

checks: shuffled benefit relative to paired same-sequence frozen comparator does not unusually exceed the retained +0.01 tolerance for h=1..5
families.direction_justification: Only excess benefit above the paired frozen comparator plus retained tolerance undermines destruction; lower differences are stronger destruction.
families.reference: 1000 exchangeable cycle-order permutations per scoring-seed sequence; d_h=shuffled_reduction_h-paired_frozen_reduction_h-0.01; statistic max_h d_h.

pre_correction_fwfp.derivation: Pairing reduces variance but does not prove the random five-horizon inequality; conservative bound is 1.

families.corrective_method: Upper-only five-horizon null-of-the-max plus-one randomization p-value over 1000 exchangeable cycle shuffles per seed and Bonferroni alpha_seed=0.05/3; retain +0.01 inside the statistic.

families.direction_justification: Any forecast statistic without a sequence violates the interface.
families.reference: Empty-sequence contract.

families.direction_justification: Either deviation means the four-combination fixture or single-axis rule is not the specified control.
families.reference: Exactly 150/200 correct by enumerated combination fixture.

families.direction_justification: Any accuracy or count mismatch means the scan control or sealed counter is malformed.
families.reference: Separate chain log has exactly 200 facts; exhaustive scan count is exact.

families.direction_justification: Any oracle mismatch is a fixture or counter construction defect.
families.reference: Ground-truth labels, paths, and exact k counts.

checks: post-freeze chain-walk accuracy==0 for all 40 queries
families.direction_justification: Any correct post-freeze path means the frozen head leaked updates; zero is required by construction.
families.reference: Head fixed at (c,4), expected paths start at (c,9); exact path equality gives zero.

checks: combination accuracy is not unusually far from its permutation-null center
families.direction_justification: Combination accuracy is a two-sided chance-calibration check; chain mismatch below one means the derangement retained true content.
families.reference: 1000 exchangeable combination-field derangements per seed plus exact deranged-content mismatch check; combo departure statistic is absolute deviation from the pooled 1001-draw mean, computed symmetrically after return.

pre_correction_fwfp.derivation: stochastic combo check: 1-(1-0.05)^3; chain check exact

families.corrective_method: For the combo check, combine observed+1000 null accuracies, compute their common mean and each absolute departure, then a tie-conservative plus-one rank p-value; Bonferroni alpha_seed=0.05/3. Chain mismatch remains exact.

families.direction_justification: Order accuracy must match exactly; chain accuracy above 0.05 means broken connectivity survived.
families.reference: Query-order invariance and a fixed-point-free edge-target derangement with exact expected chain accuracy zero.

families.direction_justification: Any numeric response on either empty fixture violates the interface.
families.reference: Empty-fixture contracts.

families.direction_justification: Any other return violates the frozen union schema.
families.reference: Exact tagged-rejection contract.

checks: all returned values retain four-field tagged structure
families.direction_justification: Any missing tag/field is structural incompleteness; content correctness is intentionally not gated.
families.reference: Frozen four-field schema under fixed content derangement.

checks: batch results identical by query ID after order shuffle
families.direction_justification: Any by-ID difference is an order-dependent wrapper defect.
families.reference: Exact permutation invariance by query ID.

families.direction_justification: Any mismatch against trusted fields is an oracle or wrapper defect.
families.reference: Trusted-zone exact field equality.

checks: serialized replay validates current tagged schema
families.direction_justification: Failure to validate is schema drift; success is exact.
families.reference: Frozen serialized union and current frozen schema.

checks: finite path-reachability probe finds no bare-content bypass
families.direction_justification: Any reachable bare-content path violates completeness.
families.reference: Frozen three-module/four-callable closed-world namespace.
